synopsis: FMI is presented as integration glue for simulation tool chains, alongside other standards, with about 250 supporting tools by mid-2025 [f8335, f8336]. A concrete cross-chapter example is Haider et al.’s tool-independent ray-traced lidar model, incorporating scan patterns and the full signal-processing chain and packaged as an ASAM OSI/FMI unit [f4504]. The vendor survey lists FMI for IPG’s CarMaker, TruckMaker and off-highway offerings, while MathWorks provides FMI through partners such as Mevea; Mevea supports Simulink co-simulation through TCP/IP or FMI [f8992, f8383, f8562]. To mitigate supplier dependence and ownership changes, the corpus recommends requiring FMI and other specified export capabilities, plus ownership-change exit clauses [f8887]. Coverage is not fully verified: FMI support for Algoryx AGX Dynamics remains unconfirmed [f9110].
